title: UC San Diego Resting State EEG Data from Patients with Parkinson's Disease
description: This dataset comprises resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) recordings collected from patients with Parkinson's disease and healthy controls at the University of San Diego. The study includes 31 participants with EEG data acquired using BioSemi systems, with Parkinson's patients recorded in both on and off dopaminergic medication states. The dataset is curated to BIDS standards and serves as a resource for investigating neurophysiological markers of Parkinson's disease, including cortical oscillations and synchronization patterns.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG recordings were acquired using BioSemi systems. Parkinson's disease patients were recorded in two sessions: one on dopaminergic medication and one off medication. Healthy control participants completed a single session. Clinical assessments included UPDRS rating scales administered by laboratory personnel trained through online certification (not board-certified neurologists). Cognitive screening was performed using the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE).
